description: This Go source file defines a utility for ordering a list of file paths based on their relative paths to a specified root directory. It includes a struct for representing file entries with both absolute and relative paths, and a function that processes the list of files, computes their relative paths, sorts them, and returns the ordered list.

classes.name: orderedFile
classes.description: A struct representing a file with its absolute and relative paths.

methods.name: orderFiles
methods.description: Takes a root directory and a list of file paths, computes their relative paths with respect to the root, sorts them, and returns the sorted list.
